answer: A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The fable counter is kept in echo and reef shows each reset. Anyone hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2576 identities would post 4637 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
